verdicts.title: On the Integrality Gap of the Subtour LP for the 1,2-TSP
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper, we study the integrality gap of the subtour LP relaxation for the traveling salesman problem in the special case when all edge costs are either 1 or 2. For the general case of symmetric costs that obey triangle inequality, a famous conjecture is that the integrality gap is 4/3. Little
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns the integrality gap of the subtour LP for the 1,2-TSP, not Max-Cut SoS-2 gaps or Fekete capacity of Laplacian spectra. It shares only the generic term 'integrality gap' with the conjecture.
